metadata.title: Ping Pong
artists: GL!CH, Kasane Teto, 重音テト

lines.text: Ping, ping, ping pong, ping, p-|ping, ping pong
Hey, hey, you look my way
then you turn and walk a|way
I go left, you go right, same old game e|ve|ry night
One, two, I run to you
three, four, you're out the door
Hit it hard, send it back to
Tick-|tock, sug|ar on my tongue, then you leave when I hold on
Round and round, I chase the sound of your voice all o|ver town
Three, four, I want you more
Ping pong, back and forth, oh
Hit it hard, send it back to
Stop the game, drop the ball
Say my name, that is all
No more tricks, no more shows
Tell me now, let me know
Ping pong, back and forth, oh
Hit it hard, send it back to me
Hit it back one more time
